messages.subject: Emphasizing my Interest in Bank of America Recruiting (Application ID: 3225121)
messages.body:
Hello Bank of America Recruiting Office,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing this email to express my continued interest in the Global Investment Banking Summer Analyst Program - 2025. I applied for this position in February, but have not received updates. If any opportunities still remain, I am highly interested in pursuing recruiting for this position where possible. Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman

messages.subject: Re: Emphasizing my Interest in Bank of America Recruiting (Application ID: 3225121)
messages.body: Additionally, attached to this email is an updated copy of my resume.

messages.subject: RE: Emphasizing my Interest in Bank of America Recruiting (Application ID: 3225121)
messages.body:
Hi,

Thank you for your inquiry. Per request, I have updated your application. All applicants are currently under review and once a decision has been made a notification will be sent out. Your patience is appreciated during this process.

Best,

Chrissonna Cohen
Global Human Resources – Talent Acquisition, Enterprise Campus Strategy
messages.note: Reply signed by Chrissonna Cohen but sent from the shared us_campus@bofa.com mailbox, in different case from the address Jon wrote to (US_Campus@). The person who answered is not the address on file.
